class.name: RandomGaeaMaterial
class.brief_description: A sampled material that chooses a material randomly based on weights.
class.description: Each material has a different weight attached to it, which affects its probably of being selected.

method.name: add_material
method.description: Adds the specified material to the list, with the specified weight.

method.name: get_material
method.description: Returns the material at the [param idx].

method.name: get_random_material
method.description: Returns a random material based on its weight, with materials with higher weight having a higher chance of being selected. Uses [param rng] for the randomization. If it fails, returns [code]null[/code].

members.member: List of materials to randomly select from. [b]Note:[/b] Setting this property updates all materials at once. [b]Note:[/b] The returned array is [i]copied[/i] and any changes to it will not update the original property value.
Whether or not this resource is sampled for every point or only once (see [method GaeaMaterial.is_sampled]).
List of weights for each material. [b]Note:[/b] Setting this property updates all weights at once.
